facts.text: I am thinking of rearranging my bookshelf.
I want tips on organizing my books by author or title.
I have been thinking about rearranging my furniture, not just my bookshelf.
I created a cozy reading nook in my living room about three weeks ago.
I created a cozy reading nook with an armchair and a floor lamp.
I replaced the table lamp on my coffee table with a new one from IKEA two weekends ago.
The IKEA table lamp on my coffee table has a USB port.
I use the USB port to charge my phone while I am watching TV.
I use the USB port to charge my tablet while I am watching TV.
I have been spending more time in the living room since I rearranged the furniture and added the cozy reading nook.
I ordered new throw pillows online last week.
The colors of the throw pillows match the rug and the wallpaper perfectly.
